name: Sheraton Towers Singapore
short_description: A Sheraton on Scotts Road, next to Newton MRT and a short walk from Orchard Road's shopping core.
ai_summary: Sheraton Towers Singapore sits on Scotts Road next to Newton MRT station, a short walk from Orchard Road's main shopping stretch. As a standard full-service Sheraton (rather than a Luxury Collection-branded conversion like Bangkok's Sheraton Grande Sukhumvit), it sits in Bonvoy's mid-to-premium tier, positioned as a more accessible alternative to the St. Regis and Ritz-Carlton properties in the city. Guest reviews are polarized: many praise the friendly, responsive staff, a peaceful pool, and a strong buffet, with executive-floor guests specifically calling out quiet, well-appointed rooms with evening snacks and drinks as good value. But a meaningful share of reviews describe dated interiors, inconsistent housekeeping (including reports of no service across multi-day stays), and a lackluster welcome that some feel doesn't match the price point outside the executive floors.

faqs.question: Are the executive floor rooms at Sheraton Towers Singapore worth the upgrade?
faqs.answer: Guest reviews suggest yes -- executive-floor rooms are specifically praised for being quieter and better-appointed, with complimentary evening snacks and drinks, while several reviews describe standard rooms elsewhere in the hotel as more dated.

faqs.question: Is Sheraton Towers Singapore close to Orchard Road?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits on Scotts Road directly next to Newton MRT station, a short walk from Orchard Road's main shopping and dining strip.

reviews.title: Review: Sheraton Towers Singapore (ft. waterfall views!)
reviews.summary: A 30sqm Deluxe King stay framed as one of the more affordable Bonvoy options in Singapore. Highlights the dramatic lobby water feature and waterfall views, the 5th-floor pool and lounge cocktail hour: a solid budget staycation pick.

reviews.title: To Singapore for the Grand Prix! Sheraton Towers Singapore – Deluxe Room review
reviews.author: Keith
reviews.summary: Reviews a Deluxe Room booked at 12,000 Starpoints, calling it excellent value against a AUD 450+ cash rate. Praises comfortable beds, high ceilings and floor space despite dated decor, plus convenient MRT access. Rated 4/5.

reviews.title: Review: Executive Suite at the Sheraton Towers Singapore
reviews.author: Brad
reviews.summary: Covers a Cambridge Towers Executive Suite booked on an award during a layover. Notes the property is not new but has renovated public spaces, dated-but-kept furnishings and a well-stocked club lounge: a decent, return-worthy option.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Sheraton Towers Singapore (Pool King Room)
reviews.author: Mark Chua
reviews.summary: Details a 32sqm Towers Pool King with club benefits after the hotel's S$20M refurbishment: plush bed, sitting area and strong breakfast buffet, while flagging slow, understaffed lounge service and a property that still shows its age.

reviews.title: The Hotel Life: Sheraton Towers Singapore Executive Suite Review
reviews.author: Dennison Wee
reviews.summary: A Wanderlust Escape package upgraded to a 60sqm Beijing Executive Suite via Platinum status. Praises the spacious suite and fresh breakfast but criticises a gloomy lobby, lacklustre check-in and disappointing lounge.
